user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking where check-in and check-out are the same date to be rejected so that same-day bookings are not allowed.

positive.title: Reject booking where check-in and check-out are the same date
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select today's date as both check-in and check-out dates.
Attempt to submit the booking form.
positive.expected_result: The system rejects the booking and displays an error message indicating that same-day bookings are not allowed.

negative.title: Allow booking where check-in and check-out dates are different
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select today's date as the check-in date and a future date as the check-out date.

edge.title: Handle booking across date boundary correctly
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select the last day of the month as the check-in date and the first day of the next month as the check-out date.
